name: french_bench_arc_challenge
description: A French-language version of the ARC Challenge set that measures a model's ability to answer challenging multiple-choice science questions requiring reasoning and world knowledge. It evaluates comprehension, multi-step reasoning, and application of grade-school to middle-school science concepts presented in French. Useful for assessing multilingual QA and reasoning capabilities.
reputation: A niche but useful multilingual adaptation of the widely used ARC Challenge, used by researchers testing reasoning and multilingual QA approaches but not as widely adopted as English ARC.
